run.kind: forward intervention on a new task with a preregistered prediction
run.status: NEW_TASK_FORWARD_TEST; T1/T2 backbones and banks pre-exist (f095 campaign), not a fresh-bank confirmation

recipe.feature_normalization: mean/std fitted on clean head-fit parents only, frozen to dev/eval; whitened variant uses the same fit covariance
recipe.mlp_selection: head-dev BCE every 10 epochs; same budget in both head regimes
recipe.head_regimes: static = clean states; flip = clean + single-edit states, 50:50 weight; identical init (zero vector / fixed torch seed)
recipe.dev_split: deterministic 80/20 parent split of the new task's train scenes (rng 4404); flips follow their parent
recipe.thresholds: J at fixed 0.0; J_head_dev_threshold from head-dev single-state weighted accuracy; J_star is the evaluation-truth oracle bound

hit_or_miss.primary_verdict: P1 AND P2 (standardized + convex logistic head)

limitations: new task is new for the O04 readout decomposition, not a fresh-bank confirmation of the project's main claim
T1/T2 backbones were trained in the f095 campaign and are re-used frozen; this script trains heads only
J_star uses evaluation truth and is a diagnostic upper bound, never deployable accuracy
S is a property of S(f_head∘h): it changes with the head, so it is not an intrinsic encoder property
3 seeds share one task/bank and are not independent tasks
paired bootstrap holds the sample-selected oracle threshold fixed for J_star and is descriptive
typed U10 arms are excluded (their frozen trunk exposes no feature head in the released checkpoints)
